subject: pattern/test-suite/compounding-emission-leak
claim: Test-emission leaks in the knowledge base are cumulative and unbounded, not fixed per run: a phase finding's idempotence key includes the commit hash (`revision`), and each pytest run of a fixture whose spec opts into `rag.emit_self`/`rag.emit_report` commits a fresh throwaway hash via `_init_repo`, so every run derives a new knowledge_id and writes a new artifact under the same entity. Measured on the durable tree: 18 `self-test_artifact_gate_*` raw artifacts (9 `..._refuses_wit0` + 9 `..._passes_when0`) and 14 registry rows referencing them; entity-level manifest compaction hides the growth, so measure leaks by raw artifact and registry-row counts, never by manifest entities.
